title: RavenClaude task-ledger config (.ravenclaude/ledger-config.json)
description: Resolution order for EVERY consumer (writer, projector, gates, hooks, CI): (1) RC_LEDGER_DIR / RC_LEDGER_VIEW — test harness only, never a documented user knob; (2) these keys; (3) defaults. ⛔ If this file exists but does not parse, the answer is UNKNOWN and a HARD STOP — never a fall-through to the defaults, because a mangled config that silently reverts writes the ledger to a second location and splits the source of truth.

ledger_dir.description: Default .ravenclaude/ledger — MEASURED committable. ⛔ .ravenclaude/runs/** is gitignored (.gitignore:4): a ledger there appends happily, exits 0, and never reaches main.

view_path.description: Generated Markdown view. docs/pm/task-list.md when docs/ exists at repo root, else <ledger_dir>/task-list.md.

stale_days.description: Taken from the incumbent templates/task-list.md rule, not invented.

aging_policy.description: rollup keeps every dormant item in open_count and in the SCP ids. auto_descope bounds the set but SILENTLY CLOSES WORK, which is the defect this ledger exists to prevent — hence not the default.

max_record_bytes.description: Gate-enforced. Keeps every record an order of magnitude below the largest measured-safe append size, so the unmeasured >64 KB atomicity region is unreachable by construction.
